resources.string: "Direct multilingual CPU translation · includes Japanese and Korean · no English bridge"
"Experimental translation · publisher authorization required · compare quality with HY-MT2"
"Speech recognition produces the original text. %1$s translates it directly on %2$s, without an English bridge. Works offline once installed."

"Sign in on the publisher’s page, accept its model terms yourself, and download the file for this processor. Return here to import that file. The app checks its SHA-256 and never reads your password or access token. Mirrors cannot replace authorization."
"This model does not support the current language pair."
"No matching NPU package for this chipset; use a portable CPU model"
"Choose languages, check the model combination, then download what is missing. You can change models later."
"No compatible offline model for this language pair on this phone. Choose another language."
"Not enough available memory. Close other apps or choose a smaller model."
"The phone is too hot. Captions paused; let it cool before restarting."
"Phone warming up · processing may slow down"
"Translation is falling behind. Recording stopped; source text is kept. Choose a smaller model and restart."
"Download: %1$s\nSpace to reserve: %2$s\nFiles are verified before installation. Resume interrupted jobs from Models."
"Allow mobile or metered data for these downloads"
"Waiting for an unmetered network. Connect to Wi-Fi, then tap Resume."
"Select the extracted folder for this exact model version. Every required file must match the published SHA-256. Other files are ignored."

"Audio and captions are processed on your phone. Downloads contact model hosts or the selected mirror. No analytics or automatic transcript uploads. Only the latest 80 lines stay in memory; export them before closing. Diagnostic reports exclude audio and captions."
"Quality evidence: English → Chinese on S25+. Other language pairs need further evaluation."
"Choose an audio source and tap Start. Speech detection reduces non-speech captions; background voices or singing may still be recognized."
"Android asks for screen capture permission to capture device audio. This app reads audio only; it does not capture screen images. Some apps block audio capture."
"No capturable audio received. Check playback; this app may block audio capture."

"Includes app version, device model, Android version, selected models and numeric performance counters. No audio, captions, IP address, account or device serial number. Review the file before sharing."
"Main screen only. Whisper translation shows intermediate English text."
"Not enough free memory. Close other apps or use an installed smaller model."
"The phone is too hot. Let it cool down before retrying."
"A required model is missing. Download it in model management or use an installed alternative."
"Translation still exceeded the output limit after splitting. The incomplete result was withheld. Retry or use another model."
"Translation took too long. Retry or use a faster installed model."
"The selected model could not run. Retry, check its files in model management, or use an installed alternative."

"Speech recognition and AI translation run on your phone. Models work offline after download. Choose speech and text models separately; each model shows its processor and language support. Captions are not sent to an external translation service."

"Use Microphone for live speech or Device audio for videos. Some apps block audio capture. Drag floating captions anywhere, tuck them at an edge and tap the handle to expand. Stop from the main screen or notification.

Choose speech, subtitle and app languages independently. Speech recognition and text translation have separate model lists. Compatible NPU options appear first. HY-MT2 provides direct CPU translation, including Japanese and Korean; some OPUS-MT routes use a Whisper English bridge. See each model for size, languages and memory requirements. Gemma3 requires authorization on the publisher’s site, then import of the matching file.

Downloads support backup channels where available and SHA-256 verification. Clear background speech or singing may still be recognized. Quality and latency depend on the model, language, phone and recording conditions."
"Independent of the main screen. Speech-to-English routes show intermediate English."
"0% solid · 100% invisible. Applies to both subtitle lines; the handle stays visible."
"Move left for automatic height. Custom height fits the screen; larger text may need extra space."
"Qualcomm applies additional use restrictions to this optimized model, including education/training, employment and emotion recognition. Read the full publisher terms before downloading."
